build_get_colors: build a python module that generates N evenly distributed HSV colors scaled to 0-255
build_get_colors_from_sem_map: build a python module that maps semantic IDs to colors matching the SSI taxonomy
build_draw_bb2s: build a python module that draws 2D bounding boxes with optional labels on an image
build_draw_obbs_image: build a python module that renders 2D and 3D oriented bounding boxes on a single image
build_draw_obbs_snippet: build a python module that renders oriented bounding boxes across a sequence of images
